# Jubilees Chapter 21 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Abraham's Instructions on Sacrifice and Purity

---

**21:1** In the sixth year of the seventh week of the forty-second jubilee, Abraham called his son Isaac and gave him these commands:

**21:2** "I am old, and I do not know the day of my death. I am full of days — one hundred and seventy-five years old.

**21:3** Throughout all the days of my life I have remembered the LORD and sought with all my heart to do his will and to walk uprightly in all his ways. I have hated idols, and have rejected those who serve them, and have given my heart and spirit to observe diligently what he desires.

**21:4** My soul has hated idols, and I have despised those who serve them. I have given my heart to love the LORD God.

**21:5** You also, my son — observe his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances. Do not follow after abominations or graven images or molten images.

**21:6** Do not eat any blood of animals or birds throughout all the days of your life. Do not eat the fat of any animal, for the blood is the life and the fat is the glory.

**21:7** You shall not eat any blood; rather, pour it out upon the altar. You shall offer upon the altar every portion of fat from the animal. Every firstborn male born among your cattle and your flocks you shall consecrate to the LORD your God.

**21:8** Every firstborn that is born among your cattle and your flocks you shall consecrate to the LORD your God, and you shall eat it in the sanctuary of the LORD your God at the place he shall choose.

**21:9** As for all the tithe of cattle and sheep — every tenth one that passes under the rod — the tenth shall be holy to the LORD.

**21:10** Offer upon the altar its fat and its blood. The flesh shall be eaten in the holy place.

**21:11** Every sacrifice you offer on the altar shall be consumed by fire; do not leave any of it until morning. The altar you shall build of stones — not of stones cut by iron tools; do not build it of hewn stone.

**21:12** Offer upon it a whole burnt offering morning and evening, a grain offering, an incense offering with frankincense in the morning, and in the evening offer incense and aromatic spices, a pleasing fragrance, and peace offerings.

**21:13** All the fat of the peace offerings offer on the altar: the fat on the intestines, the liver, and the kidneys — all this fat, and the two kidneys with all the fat on them, and the fat on the flanks and on the diaphragm you shall remove.

**21:14** Offer all this upon the altar of burnt offering. It is a food offering, a fire offering to the LORD. Offer all your peace offerings to the LORD your God in truth.

**21:15** You shall salt every offering with salt, and you shall not let the covenant of salt fail from any of your offerings before the LORD.

**21:16** As for the wood for burnt offerings, take care to bring only these kinds: cypress, pine, almond, fir, cedar, juniper, fig, olive, myrtle, laurel, aspalathus, and balsam.

**21:17** These are the kinds of wood you shall use under the burnt offering on the altar. After testing each of them, do not use any other wood under it, for the fragrance of each of these is pleasing before the LORD.

**21:18** Of all the trees in the world, these fourteen kinds of wood are those you shall use on the altar under the burnt offering.

**21:19** Guard yourself and your life from all blood, for I will require an account of all blood of living souls — from the hand of beast and from the hand of man.

**21:20** For all blood shed upon the earth before the LORD — the earth is not purified from blood except by the blood of the one who shed it.

**21:21** Do not accept a ransom for the blood of any person, lest it be shed without justice, for it is human blood that has been shed, and whoever sheds human blood shall fall into the righteous judgment of the LORD.

**21:22** My son, wash your hands and your feet before you approach the altar, and once you have washed, let no blood remain on your hands or your feet.

**21:23** Offer your burnt offering and your peace offerings. The fire on the altar shall not go out; it shall burn continually. Offer your offering upon the altar morning and evening, and burn incense upon the altar.

**21:24** Isaac said to his father: "I will observe all these things as you have commanded me. But I am afraid, father, that you may be displeased if I ask you something."

**21:25** Abraham said to him: "Ask whatever you wish, and I will tell you." Isaac said: "After you die, how shall I offer burnt offerings and sacrifices? I do not know the proper way to offer them."

**21:26** Abraham said to his son Isaac: "I have already written down for you the entire law, all the statutes, and all the ordinances which I received from the LORD on Mount Sinai from the angel of the presence, and everything written in the book of the first law."

---
*LOGOS notes: The fourteen permitted altar-woods (vv.16-18) are unique to Jubilees. "Covenant of salt" (v.15) = Lev 2:13. Abraham's receipt of the law via the angel of the presence on Sinai (v.26) is Jubilees' characteristic retroactive attribution of Mosaic law to the patriarchal period.*
